title: FaultControl
description: Payload used to inject and inspect fault modes in Department microservices

department.description: Target department (required for orchestrator proxy, optional on direct department endpoint)

mode.description: none: normal operation; offline: HTTP 503; slow: sleep delay_ms; error: HTTP 500

delay_ms.description: Sleep duration when mode is 'slow' (must exceed orchestrator timeout of 2000ms)
